MACRO.label: MacroSentinel
MACRO.description: Weekly. Reads 8 economic indicators (Alpha Vantage) and writes a risk regime to macro_signals. Consumed by ResearchAgent's macro score, DeepDive, and Mentor. Purely advisory — never places or blocks a trade by itself.
MACRO.addReason: Give every downstream score a macro context input.

RESEARCH.label: ResearchAgent
RESEARCH.description: Daily per market. Scores each tracked symbol deterministically across fundamental, technical, sentiment, macro, and insider evidence using market-local champion weights. Watchlists are partitioned by market and research_enabled; holdings persist is_holding=true and are staleness-ordered. Held rows skip optional LLM narrative to protect coverage; new candidates may receive narrative that cannot alter scores or directions. Sentiment is sample-shrunk, analyst targets are observational only, and India never inherits the US macro regime. Writes agent_signals, signal_score_history, and decision observations.
RESEARCH.addReason: Central scoring engine — everything downstream keys off its analyst_score.
RESEARCH.changeReason: Research Journal — wired signal_id through and added screener/stage instrumentation (Decision 40).

SCOREHIST.label: signal_score_history
SCOREHIST.description: Append-only per-symbol score log (migration 054/055). Never mutated after insert. Feeds the Score Tracker chart AND is read back by ResearchAgent as trend context so it reasons about rising/falling conviction, not a cold snapshot.
SCOREHIST.addReason: The score-history data model — previously the trajectory chart had no durable source.

CHAMPION.label: Champion weights
CHAMPION.description: The promoted strategy_versions row (is_champion=true) whose weights_snapshot ResearchAgent reads. This is where a human-approved LearnerAgent improvement finally takes effect. Before 2026-07-05 nothing read it — the loop was open and approved learning evaporated. Phase 4: ONE champion PER MARKET (strategy_versions.market) — an India stock scores off India-learned weights, a US stock off US weights. India's champion is seeded as a clone of the US champion (a prior) and diverges as India accrues its own trades.
CHAMPION.addReason: Closes the learning loop — Learner learns → you promote → Research scores differently.
CHAMPION.changeReason: Per-market champions — India rides a US-cloned prior until it earns its own weights.

TRADER.label: PaperTrader
TRADER.description: Deterministic flow (no LLM). Reads fresh pending deterministic long signals at the market's trading-mandate threshold, then requires latched pause + trading-enabled controls and per-market kill switches. Opens through row-locked execute_paper_fill: signal CAS, 10-distinct-alpha-name cap, no-average-down pyramid gate, mandate provenance, trade/position/native-currency cash all commit or roll back together. US USD and India INR pools are never summed. Portfolio construction still applies name/sector/gross/vol/correlation limits, optional calibrated Kelly sizing, and dynamic stop/target evidence. Standalone per-market fill crons are primary; the research tail-call is a claim-safe backstop. Same-market-day freshness and re-entry cooldown remain enforced.
TRADER.addReason: Turns qualifying signals into paper positions.
TRADER.changeReason: Mandate-canonical threshold, latched market controls, atomic mandate provenance, and concurrency-safe 10-name/no-average-down RPC gates.

MONITOR.label: PositionMonitor
MONITOR.description: Daily post-close per market. Refreshes prices and applies deterministic score, direction, time, trailing-stop, target, and hedge exits. Every full or partial exit calls execute_paper_exit, a row-locked FIFO transaction that realizes closed lots (including partial-lot slices), updates/deletes the position, credits only that market's native-currency pool, and journals the decision atomically. After exits it reconciles cash/NAV, syncs VOO/^NSEI, and can pause only the affected market on weekly drawdown. Exits remain allowed while entries are paused.
MONITOR.changeReason: Full and partial paper exits now commit FIFO lots, position, native-currency cash, and decision journal through one fail-closed transaction.

EXITS.label: Exit + close
EXITS.description: execute_paper_exit is the single atomic close path: FIFO lot realization, partial-lot split when needed, position update/delete, one native-currency cash credit, and decision-journal write. Closed trade ids then feed RAG best-effort. A quantity mismatch rolls back instead of corrupting accounting.
EXITS.addReason: Single close path so cash is credited exactly once.

LEARNER.label: LearnerAgent
LEARNER.description: Weekly (Friday). Evaluates a market's closed-trade cohort and proposes weight-change CHALLENGERS into strategy_versions — it does NOT mutate live weights or sell live positions. Gated by a phase gate (10+ closed trades) and an auto-guard. Phase 4: analyzes ONE market per run (US today) and proposes challengers ONLY for that market's champion, so a bad India run can never shift US weights. India gets its own cohort once it clears the 10+ closed-trade gate.
LEARNER.addReason: Learn from outcomes and evolve the scoring weights.
LEARNER.changeReason: Per-market cohorts + per-market challengers — India learning can't contaminate US. (Also: no longer timer-sells; reconciliation only.)

CHALLENGER.label: Challenger weights
CHALLENGER.description: An immutable strategy_versions row (is_champion=false) holding a proposed weight change. Inert until a human promotes it — the architecture gate that stops the AI silently overwriting the live strategy.

GENOME.label: Strategy Genome
GENOME.description: Phase 3 learning-core (strategy_versions.genome jsonb, migration 063). Extends what a challenger can evolve beyond the 5 top-level weights: entry threshold, horizon, exit family (ledger-percentile stops/targets — the same math Phase 2's dynamic R:R already uses), sizing mode, universe, regime router. Hard search-domain bounds enforced in code (lib/validation/genome.ts), not just documented — an out-of-bounds proposal is rejected before it can reach validation. A genome-less strategy_versions row scores exactly as before (legacy 5-weight path) — fully additive.
GENOME.addReason: Reweighting 5 fixed dials can only remix existing assumptions — the genome gives evolution more to actually change.

REGISTRY.label: Feature Registry
REGISTRY.description: Phase 3 learning-core (feature_registry table, migration 064). LearnerAgent's new propose_feature tool proposes a machine-readable spec (rationale, formula, inputs, falsification test) — the formula is NEVER executed as code, only interpreted through a whitelisted expression grammar (lib/validation/feature-compiler.ts: + - * / and log/abs/min/max/lag only, tokenized + parsed, no eval()). A weekly feature-check job (app/api/validation/feature-check) computes out-of-sample Spearman rank-IC across walk-forward folds; promotes proposed→quarantined→active on |IC|>=0.03 & p<0.1 across 2+ of 3 folds, auto-retires actives whose rolling IC falls below 0.01 for 3 checks. Only 'active' features ever reach the calibration fit — proposing a feature has ZERO effect on live scoring.
REGISTRY.addReason: Edge compounds through discovering, validating, and retiring features — not just remixing a fixed 5-dimension scorecard.

SHADOW.label: Shadow Decisions
SHADOW.description: Phase 3 learning-core (shadow_decisions table, migration 065). ResearchAgent records what up to 3 strategy_versions in state='shadow_paper' would have decided on every candidate — pure scoring replay, no fills, no cash, alongside the champion's real decision. Off by default: nothing enters shadow_paper without explicit action (or a bounded weekly auto-promotion gated by strategy_config.exploration_enabled, default false). Lets a challenger's edge be observed against live, contemporaneous opportunities before it ever risks paper capital.
SHADOW.addReason: Offline backtests alone can't expose live feature availability or changing market structure; live paper capital is unsafe to risk on an unvalidated challenger. Shadow bridges the two.

VALIDATE.label: Validation Engine
VALIDATE.description: Phase 2 learning-core (lib/validation/engine.ts, migration 061). Deterministic, NO LLM — replays champion vs challenger weights as a scoring-REPLAY against purged/embargoed walk-forward folds from the decision ledger (lib/learning/dataset.ts), then requires evidence before a challenger may be promoted: p_improvement >= 0.80 (1000-draw moving-block bootstrap, fixed seed), paired-diff CI floor, n_effective (overlap-adjusted) >= 12, wins >= 3 of 5 folds. Writes a validation_experiments row every run (pass or fail). The promote_champion route is FAIL-CLOSED on this — no passed experiment, no promotion (a journaled force_unvalidated override exists but is not the default path). Fires automatically when LearnerAgent creates a challenger (now IN-PROCESS via runAutomatedValidation in lib/validation/automation.ts — replaced the old fire-and-forget localhost request); also runnable on demand (Validate button, Agents page). Automated validation is gated per-market by strategy_validation_automation (migration 170, fail-closed): on a PASSED experiment AND auto_shadow_enabled, the challenger is atomically routed to state='shadow_paper' via the activate_strategy_shadow RPC (service_role only, per-market advisory lock + max_active_shadows 0-1 cap) — the ONLY automatic lifecycle transition, non-executing, cannot promote/fill/order. A Friday recovery cron kairos-validation-sweep (21:45 UTC, /api/validation/sweep) validates up to 5 never-validated challengers/market. Owner toggles both switches in Settings -> Automatic Strategy Validation.
VALIDATE.addReason: Human approval alone was governance, not evidence — a persuasive-but-wrong challenger could become the live scoring policy. This makes promotion require walk-forward proof.

PROMOTE.label: You promote (Strategy Registry)
PROMOTE.description: Human review step — now the FINAL gate after evidence, not a substitute for it. Promoting a challenger in the Strategy Registry flips it to champion (blocked with HTTP 412 unless VALIDATE passed) — and ResearchAgent actually consumes it on its next run.
PROMOTE.addReason: Keep a human in control of what the AI is allowed to change.
PROMOTE.changeReason: Now sits AFTER the Validation Engine gate, not instead of it — see VALIDATE.

MENTOR.label: MentorAgent
MENTOR.description: Reads your trade outcomes + learner runs and writes coaching insights (mentor_insights). Advisory to YOU — does not touch positions or weights.
MENTOR.addReason: Coach the human, not just the portfolio.

REALORDER.label: Manual real-order execution (Robinhood)
REALORDER.description: Robinhood has no public order API, so live trading through it stays manual by design. Approving a proposal generates an exact natural-language command to paste into a Claude session with Robinhood MCP access (account 605420660 only). The app never claims a fill it didn't make.
REALORDER.addReason: execClaude cannot actually call broker tools — a generated command keeps the human in the loop instead of faking fills.
REALORDER.changeReason: GATEWAY (below) now covers Alpaca-backed paper orders; Robinhood stays manual since it has no API.

GATEWAY.label: Execution Gateway (broker registry: Alpaca/Kite)
GATEWAY.description: Typed broker order lifecycle for approved trade_proposals, routed through lib/brokers/registry.ts (getActiveBroker per market, strategy_config.active_broker_us/india) instead of a direct Alpaca import: submit -> pending_submit/submitted/partially_filled/filled/canceled/rejected, polled + reconciled every 30 min (app/api/broker/orders/sync — now iterates DISTINCT brokers present in open orders, so Alpaca and Kite orders can be in-flight simultaneously). A 'Send to Alpaca (paper)' button on Smart Money's Trade Queue (status='approved' only) fires this — human click required, never cron-fired. Adding a future broker (E*TRADE etc.) is one adapter file + one registry line, zero route changes. Fixed a discovered pre-existing bug in the original build: the Trade Queue UI read a separate, never-populated `trade_queue` table while Approve/Reject/the Gateway all operate on `trade_proposals` — repointed. Live-env orders require strategy_config.trading_enabled=true (global master switch, off by default) AND the market-specific trading_enabled_us/trading_enabled_india flag (both default true, independently toggleable in Settings → Agents — turning one off blocks only new live orders for that market, holdings/balances stay fully viewable); only the PAPER path is verified live.
GATEWAY.addReason: First typed (non-manual) execution path — the honest gap flagged when auditing risk-reward/execution architecture earlier this session. Broker-swappable by design (see lib/brokers registry pattern already used for Alpaca/Kite reads).
GATEWAY.changeReason: Ops spec Part 2: routes now go through a typed broker adapter registry instead of a direct Alpaca import — multi-broker (Alpaca US / Kite India) support with zero-route-change swapping. Later same day: added independent per-market trading_enabled_us/trading_enabled_india view-only-vs-auto-trading toggle, separate from the Kite disconnect kill-switch.

YAHOO.label: Yahoo .NS data (India)
YAHOO.description: Free Yahoo Finance is the India data source (Kite Personal tier has no market data). The chart endpoint gives price + candles (no auth); the cookie+crumb quoteSummary gives fundamentals (P/E, ROE, margins). Mapped into the same shape the US scorer expects, so Indian stocks run the identical 5-dimension pipeline. Candidates come from a static NIFTY-50 list.
YAHOO.addReason: Score real NSE stocks on free data, keyed off market_focus = India.

INDIA.label: India signals
INDIA.description: Indian stocks are scored + tracked (Score Tracker, /dashboard/india) AND (Phase 4) paper-traded in their own ₹ pool — no longer excluded. The old single-USD-pool constraint is gone: PaperTrader now keeps a separate India ₹ pool so INR fills never corrupt US NAV. India is ALSO acted on via real Kite orders (the /dashboard/india confirm path). Gated by market_focus including India — a non-destructive toggle.
INDIA.addReason: Track India like US without corrupting the USD paper NAV.
INDIA.changeReason: India now paper-trades in its own ₹ pool (Phase 4) — closes India's learning loop.

NSE.label: NSE direct feeds (India)
NSE.description: Direct NSE India JSON (free, cookie handshake — lib/nse-data.ts) for the things Yahoo can't give: the full ~2000-name equity universe (EQUITY_L.csv → nightly india_screen_cache for the full-market Scanner), SEBI insider disclosures (corporates-pit), and option-chain OI/PCR ('options flow'). Fails soft — NSE geo-throttles some non-India IPs, so callers fall back to Yahoo/NIFTY-100 with an honest note. Feeds the India Scanner + Smart Money panels, not the agent loop directly.
NSE.addReason: Lift the two free-data ceilings (full-market scan + India insider/options) Yahoo alone couldn't.

LEDGER.label: Decision ledger
LEDGER.description: Phase 1 learning-core (decision_observations + observation_labels, migrations 059/060). Every candidate ResearchAgent scores — filled OR rejected — writes an immutable point-in-time observation (raw features, availability mask, weights used, score, action). A nightly label-maturation cron computes forward-horizon (2/5/10/20d) benchmark-neutral returns + MAE/MFE once each horizon matures, WITHOUT leaking future data into the features. LearnerAgent's query_score_correlation now reads this ledger first (all candidates, horizon-aligned, benchmark-neutral) instead of the old fills-only, policy-P&L, symbol-keyed join.
LEDGER.addReason: Fix the learning label — the old dataset was fills-only, policy-P&L (not alpha), and joined by symbol (collision-prone). This is the ground truth the whole learning/evolution roadmap (Phases 2-3) is built on.

KITE.label: Zerodha Kite (India execution)
KITE.description: Real NSE/BSE orders via Kite Connect. Human-confirmed standalone orders pass identity, market-control, kill-switch, risk, budget, and account gates. Kite GTT children are LIMIT orders, so protection has stop-limit gap risk. An explicit SELL cancels and confirms every recorded resting GTT before submission; cancellation uncertainty fails closed and raises a critical health issue.
KITE.addReason: The one thing free India data can't do — real execution.
KITE.changeReason: Codex Phase-B re-review #2/#3: identity gate moved from allowlist-text-only to a verified check (Kite /user/profile user_id must equal active_account_india) at the placeEquityOrder choke point, so the canonical/autonomous/exit paths get the same floor as the standalone route — not just the route.

HEALTH.label: Health-Triage
HEALTH.description: Every 6h + on demand. Deterministic read-only SRE reconciliation: current open agent_alerts plus only the latest run per agent/market produce health_triage structured issues. A recovered old error is not current truth. Snapshots carry alert count/time; Home marks mismatches stale and treats an unreadable alert feed as unavailable, never green. Provider pressure is collapsed when exhausted. Robinhood token health remains proactively checked. No LLM classification and no config/order/weight/code mutation.
HEALTH.addReason: Self-healing Part B: surface + explain system issues without any autonomous remediation of money/config/code.
HEALTH.changeReason: Operational classification is deterministic; stale/unavailable health snapshots cannot masquerade as current green status.

WATCHDOG.label: Watchdog
WATCHDOG.description: Every 2h janitor (migration 131). Reaps zombie agent_runs (status='running' past 15min), reverts orphaned 'claiming' signals to pending + clears claim stamps, and expires stale pending long signals per market-local day. Bounded status corrections only — never money/positions/ledgers/config.
WATCHDOG.addReason: Paper-fill reliability: reap the zombie runs + stuck claims + stale pending the US 0-fills bug created; keep the signal lifecycle clean.

EDGELAB.label: EdgeScout / EdgeIC (measure-only factor lab)
EDGELAB.description: Deterministic price/volume edge library + Information-Coefficient gate (features/edge-factor-discovery, P0/P1). Computes edge_signals + edge_ic_history and an advisory edge lifecycle status, surfaced read-only on /dashboard/edges. MEASURE-ONLY: never feeds analyst_score, agent_signals, paper fills, sizing, or any live order. The broad-universe IC run found the simple price/volume edges do NOT clear the significance bar yet — the gate correctly refused to promote them.
EDGELAB.addReason: Move discovery from LLM-invents-themes toward validated deterministic factors; measure IC before anything trades.

AUTOSHADOW.label: AutonomousShadow
AUTOSHADOW.description: Weekdays 07:30 UTC (Vercel cron, 30 min after research). Reads qualifying agent_signals (score_source='deterministic_v1', direction=long, score≥threshold, last 24h). Runs the 9-gate execution kernel (lib/trading/execution-kernel.ts evaluateAutonomousExecution) and the Kelly sizing kernel (computeAutonomousSizing) for each. Creates trade_proposals with execution_mode='autonomous_shadow'. Gate 1 (AUTONOMOUS_LIVE_ENABLED=false in current deployment) makes every proposal land manual_review_required — intentional until all L4 launch blockers are cleared. No broker call, no budget reservation, no order submission. NAV from live_account_snapshots (account 605420660, read-only); Kelly from last 100 closed paper_trades; budget dry-run reads broker_orders spend today (informational). Journals each run to decision_journal.
AUTOSHADOW.addReason: PA1/PA2 shadow autonomous path — accumulate evidence that the kernel gates behave correctly before enabling live orders.

SHADOWPROP.label: Shadow trade_proposals
SHADOWPROP.description: trade_proposals rows with execution_mode='autonomous_shadow'. Status is queued_auto (all 9 gates + sizing passed) or manual_review_required (any gate/sizing failure). In the current deployment, AUTONOMOUS_LIVE_ENABLED=false means gate 1 always fires → all land manual_review_required. Owner can review these in the UI; no auto-promotion or broker submit path exists yet.
SHADOWPROP.addReason: Audit trail for autonomous shadow decisions without any financial exposure.

AUTOLIVE.label: AutonomousLive
AUTOLIVE.description: Weekdays 14:00 UTC (Vercel cron, after research at 13:00 UTC). Reads qualifying agent_signals for markets in autonomous mode (live_auto_mode_us/india='autonomous' in strategy_config). Dual gate: BOTH deployment env var AUTONOMOUS_LIVE_ENABLED=true AND DB toggle live_auto_enabled must be true; neither alone allows orders. Runs the same 9-gate execution kernel (evaluateAutonomousExecution) and Kelly sizing kernel (computeAutonomousSizing) as the shadow path. Per market: US orders via direct Robinhood REST (lib/brokers/robinhood/rest-client.ts — OAuth token from api_key_vault; no MCP in serverless); India orders via Kite REST (placeEquityOrder in lib/kite.ts). Budget reserved atomically via reserve_live_order_budget_v2 RPC with p_execution_actor='autonomous_worker'. Writes broker_orders + appends broker_order_events (actor_kind='autonomous_live'). Proposals land queued_auto (submitted) or manual_review_required (any gate/sizing/RPC/broker failure). Per-market: US and India independently toggled — autonomous mode on one doesn't affect the other. Current deployment: AUTONOMOUS_LIVE_ENABLED=false, so cron is a no-op until owner sets env var AND enables DB toggle.
AUTOLIVE.addReason: PA3 autonomous live execution — agents evaluate signals and submit live orders directly (no per-order owner click) when deployment flag + DB toggle + 9 gates all clear.

LIVEAUDIT.label: Live order audit (broker_orders + broker_order_events)
LIVEAUDIT.description: broker_orders: typed order lifecycle (submitted → filled/rejected/canceled), polled by broker-sync cron. broker_order_events: append-only audit trail (boe_block_mutation trigger blocks UPDATE/DELETE) — every status transition written with actor_kind='autonomous_live' and auto_run_id linking back to the AutonomousLive run. Together they form the immutable record of every live order the autonomous path has ever attempted.
LIVEAUDIT.addReason: Immutable audit trail for all autonomous live order activity — required for reconciliation and owner review.

PERFTRUTH.label: Performance Truth Layer
PERFTRUTH.description: Deterministic, mandate-aware, append-only evaluation layer (migrations 133/134/135). investment_mandates table seeds default mandates ('Swing US 2-20d' / 'Swing India 2-20d') with benchmark symbols (VOO/NIFTY50.NS). mandate_id is stamped on agent_signals, paper_trades, decision_observations so trades attribute to a mandate. strategy_evaluations (append-only, trigger-guarded) stores evaluation snapshots: book Sharpe/Sortino/MaxDD/win-rate/alpha/cost-adjusted-return/exec-slip vs modeled, plus opp_* opportunity columns (null in P0, populated in P1). lib/evaluation/run-evaluation.ts is pure deterministic math — no LLM, no weight mutation. UI: mandate selector + 'Run Evaluation' button + eval history table on /dashboard/learning. eligible_for_live_review is advisory ONLY — never read by broker gateway. P1 gate cron (weekly Sunday 02:00 UTC) counts closed evaluable trades per market; surfaces System Health info alert when ≥ 20 accumulate (signals P1 opportunity-level IC is ready to build).
PERFTRUTH.addReason: Mandate-aware truth ledger that answers 'did this strategy create repeatable benchmark-relative edge?' before promotion gates can fire. Deterministic — no LLM in the evaluation path.

ACCTBOOK.label: Live account book

Plus Zerodha Kite India. Supplies per-account holdings (qty, current price, average cost, market value), fresh quotes, and per-symbol candle history to the HoldingRisk engine. HoldingRisk never places, cancels, or modifies any order against these accounts — it only reads them.

HOLDINGRISK.label: HoldingRisk
HOLDINGRISK.description: Daily Per-Holding Risk Analytics engine (spec: features/holding-risk-daily/FEATURE_ARCHITECTURE.md; tables holding_risk_runs + holding_risk_snapshots + account_risk_snapshots via migrations 154/155, append-only + UPDATE/DELETE-blocking triggers + owner-email RLS; cron migration 156). Fires POST /api/agents/holding-risk?market=us|india once per weekday after the respective exchange close AND after the authoritative account-snapshot refresh (US 21:30 UTC, India 11:00 UTC). HYBRID design: lib/risk/holding-risk.ts computes a deterministic 'risk-control pressure index' 0-100 (component caps name 30 / sector 20 / vol-beta 15 / cluster 15 / drawdown 10 / liquidity 10) AND the risk posture (hold / trim / exit_review / review / insufficient_data) with strict precedence (verified protective-stop or thesis-break -> exit_review; drawdown ALONE never; hard NAME/cluster breach, or a SECTOR breach this name was SELECTED to absorb -> trim; a sector breach with no usable allocation -> review; data confidence <0.5 -> review). A sector-cap breach is a property of the SECTOR and carries no per-name allocation, so it is never applied as a blanket per-name trim: lib/risk/sector-breach.ts (sba-v1, pure, deterministic, risk-internal -- reads NO research/analyst_score and no LLM) water-fills the breached sector's largest names down to a common level L where sum(min(w,L)) = cap, on the NAV basis, deciding WHICH names absorb the breach and HOW MUCH each gives up. Names below L get hold WITH the reason they were not selected. The allocator is consulted strictly BELOW the exit branch and can never delay or suppress a risk-driven exit. Unknown-sector holdings are excluded from every sector total and reported as unknown -- never bucketed into a synthetic sector, never assumed cap-compliant. An LLM writes ONLY the human-readable strategy_note explanation — it CANNOT change the score, posture, or action. Fails closed (publishes a failed/insufficient-data run, never yesterday-as-today) when a broker snapshot is missing/stale. No cross-currency roll-up (USD and INR never summed). Formula stamped hr-v2 (hr-v1 = the pre-allocator blanket sector trim; deltas are never compared across formula versions). This engine is ADVISORY-ONLY: the strategy line reaches NO order path for ANY account and applies to read-only 965848641 identically.
HOLDINGRISK.addReason: Owner asked for live per-holding risk analytics — score, posture, and a plain-language strategy note per holding across all live accounts, recomputed daily. Built deterministic-first (engine owns score + posture) so an LLM can explain but never move a risk control or an order.

RISKDASH.label: /dashboard/risk — Daily Per-Holding Risk panel
RISKDASH.description: Portfolio Risk page (components/dashboard/PortfolioRiskPage.tsx) 'Daily Per-Holding Risk' section. Reads GET /api/portfolio/risk-daily?market=&accountId= (owner-email RLS scoped, complete runs only, one latest run per account, previous run matched on same formula_version for honest Delta-vs-yesterday). Renders per-account tabs, a cadence header (Daily badge, last computed, data-as-of, formula version, data confidence), a missing-inputs banner, and an expandable per-holding table: score chip, posture pill, 1-day score delta, risk-driver breakdown, and the LLM strategy_note labeled 'advisory'. Read-only accounts additionally show 'advisory only · no order path'. A footer disclaimer states score + posture are deterministic and the strategy note cannot change them. Consumes the risk snapshots; produces no signals and touches no order path. Since 2026-07-17 each holding row also carries a nullable `research` display block (score, direction, scored_at, sessions_since, days_since, state, scored_as_holding) joined from the LATEST agent_signals row per (symbol, market) — never symbol alone, so US and India books cannot cross-join. THIS IS A DISPLAY JOIN AND NOTHING MORE: the risk score, posture and action on the same row were computed by HoldingRisk without any research input and are replayed verbatim from the snapshot; no field of the research block is read by computeHoldingRisk, sba-v1, constructPortfolio, the execution kernel, or any gate (invariant R1, pinned by tests/risk-research-annotation.test.ts). Staleness is measured in market-local SESSIONS (reusing marketSessionsSince) and displayed in DAYS, with four non-interchangeable states: fresh / stale (> 2 sessions) / never (no signal ever — deliberately NOT a link) / unavailable (research abstained — never rendered as a number). Fail-soft: if the agent_signals read errors the risk table still renders and the column says 'research unavailable' explicitly — research absence never blanks the risk product. Each annotated row deep-links to /dashboard/research-journal?symbol=&market=. Spec: features/risk-research-visibility/FEATURE_ARCHITECTURE.md.

EVIDCOHORT.label: Evidence Cohort Builder

history.label: Sector-cap breach is now ALLOCATED per name (hr-v1 -> hr-v2; new risk-internal allocator lib/risk/sector-breach.ts, sba-v1)
history.reason: Defect fix INTERNAL to the HOLDINGRISK node's own compute -- no agent-to-agent flow, handoff, table dependency, schedule, or learning-loop edge changed, so the diagram itself is unchanged. hr-v1 treated a SECTOR-cap breach as a per-name verdict, but sectorUtil >= 1 is the identical number for every holding in the sector, so EVERY Technology name got the identical 'trim' with no size and no answer to which names should absorb the breach (shipped live for AVGO in read-only 965848641: 'Trim your position because Technology holdings exceed the 30% sector cap (at 65.6%)'). hr-v2 consults a new pure allocator (sba-v1) that water-fills the breached sector's largest names down to a common level L where sum(min(w,L)) = cap, on the NAV basis (reduction = S - c*NAV; live-portfolio-gate enforces the owner's cap as value/NAV, and the invested basis would make the advice ~43% wrong). Chosen over pro-rata (which re-ships the same blanket verdict and leaves the name-cap breach untouched) and over marginal-contribution-first (for a sector-WEIGHT cap a name's marginal contribution IS its weight). RISK-INTERNAL: a function of position weights and one owner-set cap, with ZERO research/analyst_score coupling. Exits untouched: the exit_review branch is first and unconditional, so no allocation -- and no absence of one -- can delay or suppress a protective-stop/thesis-break exit. Defaults to honest: a sector breach with no usable allocation yields review + missing_inputs [sector_breach_allocation], never a fallback to the old blanket trim. Sector-unknown degrades honestly. The LLM remains prose-only and is now provably so (lib/risk/strategy-notes.ts parseStrategyNotes can only emit Map<requestedSymbol,string>). Read-only accounts (all but 605420660) are labelled advisory-informational in the deterministic action_reason. Still ADVISORY-ONLY, wired to NO order path, no migration.

history.label: Asset allocator no longer applies the US macro regime to India; macro_regime reads are market-scoped, age-bounded (10d) and indicator-backed (>=3), fail-safe to UNAVAILABLE -> NO allocation (lib/allocation/allocator.ts + new lib/allocation/regime.ts)
history.reason: Table-dependency correction on a path with NO node of its own, so the DIAGRAM IS UNCHANGED -- stated explicitly rather than silently: the asset allocator (lib/allocation/allocator.ts, migration 175) is not represented anywhere on this map. It has no node and no edge; its only consumer is TRADER (app/api/agents/paper-trade), where the equity-sleeve target may only SHRINK that market's gross-equity cap. It was never mapped because it is shipped OFF (strategy_config.allocation_enabled=false, verified false in prod dionkikgdmlaotvtbnfr), so it is not part of live agent collaboration. This entry is keyed to TRADER as the sole consumer. The MACRO -->|macro_signals| RESEARCH edge is deliberately NOT touched here -- the macro-read change owns that correction. DEFECT (verified in prod, latent not live): computeAllocation filtered strategy_sleeves by market but then read macro_regime with no market scope, and macro_regime HAS NO market column (id, week_of, danger_score, regime, signals_triggered, ai_bubble_score, summary, raw_indicators, created_at) while MacroSentinel is US-only by construction (8 US FRED series). India sleeves DO exist in prod (equity 70 / defensive_etf 20 / cash 10), so with allocation_enabled=true the US Fed's verdict would have tilted Indian sleeve weights -- the same contamination class as the macro_score defect fixed on 2026-07-16, and a per-market/per-currency violation. Reproduced against pre-fix code: a US 'bear' verdict tilted INDIA equity below its 70 target. FIX mirrors the lib/data/scores.ts contract (imports its MAX_MACRO_AGE_DAYS rather than re-declaring the bound): India returns UNAVAILABLE WITHOUT querying macro_regime at all; US rows must have a real verdict (regime != unknown), be within 10 days of week_of, and rest on >= 3 raw_indicators. The indicator floor -- not the age bound -- is what rejects the prod 2026-06-30 fossil (regime 'green', danger_score 0, signals_triggered 0, raw_indicators [], summary 'No recession signals. Economy in expansion.'): a failed run fossilized as a calm verdict, which an age bound cannot catch while it is fresh. signals_triggered=0 is deliberately NOT the discriminator (a genuinely calm week trips zero signals; rejecting those would bias the book bearish). Row selection now orders by week_of, not created_at, which could invert true order (the 2026-06-29 row was written 2026-06-30). MACRO UNAVAILABLE -> NO allocation (null), never an untilted config echo: emitting base target_pct with tilt=0 would be byte-identical to a real 'macro says neutral' verdict -- the neutral-50-and-included fake in a different hat. Accepted tension, stated not hidden: because the equity target only ever SHRINKS the gross cap, null leaves the owner's configured max_gross_exposure_pct in force, which is LOOSER than any regime outcome -- but that is the documented default (identical to allocation_enabled=false, today's live state), not a fabricated one; tightening on absent evidence would be an unapproved position change justified by nothing. No migration; adding a market column to macro_regime is the right long-term fix and is filed as a proposal, not applied. NOT FIXED, reported separately: normalizeRegime maps every label MacroSentinel actually writes (green/orange/red/unknown) to 'neutral', so the regime tilt is dead in prod today -- correcting that vocabulary would ACTIVATE tilting, a real behaviour change outside this fix's scope.

history.label: India SEBI PIT evaluated as the India insider_score source and REJECTED on live evidence -- no edge added, diagram unchanged
history.reason: Task was to wire NSE's SEBI PIT (Prohibition of Insider Trading) disclosures -- fetchNseInsider, lib/nse-data.ts -- into resolveInsider so India's insider_score (1 of the 5 genome dimensions) stopped being structurally excluded. The data was qualified against the 34 real India symbols in the live book BEFORE any wiring, and it FAILED: any PIT row inside the US 90d window = 2/34 (6%); symbols clearing the US bar of >=3 open-market txns in 90d (MIN_INSIDER_TRANSACTIONS=3) = 0/34 (0%); widening to 365d rescues only 1/10 large caps. Semantics fail independently: US insider_score is a 90d open-market (P/S only) buy/sell VALUE ratio, but only ~30% of PIT rows are open-market (Market Purchase 9.7% + Market Sale 19.5%) -- the rest are ESOP allotments (29.2%), Off Market (22.1%), Gift (5.3%), pledges, amalgamations -- and PIT's tdpTransactionType marks an ESOP ALLOTMENT AS 'Buy', so a naive wiring would score routine equity compensation as insider conviction. Freshness was fine (intimDt-acqfromDt: p50 2d, p90 34d) and NSE did not throttle, so density+semantics were the disqualifiers, not lag. VERDICT: do not wire. NO DIAGRAM CHANGE IS CORRECT HERE -- no agent-to-agent flow, handoff, table dependency, schedule, or learning-loop edge moved: India's insider dimension stays exactly where it already was (applicableDimensions() omits insider for India, availability_mask.insider=false on all India rows, weights renormalize onto the remaining dimensions). The existing NSE -->|India insider/options/scan| INDIA edge is the DISPLAY path (route -> SmartMoneyPage) and is untouched; it was deliberately NOT redrawn, because the provider->scoring dependency this task considered adding was never added. Recorded so the rejection is not silently re-litigated: the 0%-at-90d open-market density is the gate to revisit. Pinned by tests/india-insider-not-wired.test.ts (mutation-verified: importing fetchNseInsider into research-agent.ts fails the guard). SEPARATE, NOT FIXED (display-only, no consumer, reported in docs/arch ch.03 + WORK_LOG): fetchNseInsider() with no symbol returns data:[] unconditionally because NSE's market-wide PIT requires from_date/to_date which it never sends, and SmartMoneyPage calls it with no symbol -- so that NSE insider edge has never actually delivered a row (same class as the 2026-07-16 EDGAR Form 4 404); the per-symbol call likewise sends no date window, so NSE returns the latest ~20 disclosures regardless of age (RELIANCE spans back to 24-Sep-2021) while the route reports available: trades.length>0.

history.label: macro_score is US-only: India's macro dimension is UNAVAILABLE and excluded, not borrowed from the US (edge relabelled macro_signals -> macro_regime — US only)
history.reason: Retroactive map correction: the fix shipped in lib/data/scores.ts (merged at ffd8821d) WITHOUT a diagram update, so the map kept asserting an unqualified MACRO -->|macro_signals| RESEARCH edge that was wrong on both scope and table. SCOPE: macro_regime has NO market column and MacroSentinel is 8 US FRED series by construction (yield curve, Sahm rule, US GDP, nonfarm payrolls, US CPI, US retail sales, fed funds, US durables), so reading it unfiltered stamped the US Fed's verdict onto Indian equities — on the MONEY PATH (macro_score is a genome dimension -> weighted analyst score -> direction gate -> paper buys). Prod proof: both markets sat at macro_score 60.00 (= 100 - danger 40) off the same US row. FIX: India -> macro UNAVAILABLE (excluded from the weighted score, weight renormalized onto the remaining dimensions), NOT a fake-neutral 50 that still counts as evidence and NOT an invented India regime; plus a 10-day age bound and a raw_indicators >= 3 indicator floor for US. The floor is not redundant with the age bound: the 2026-06-30 prod row is green/danger_score 0/signals_triggered 0 with raw_indicators [] — a FAILED run fossilized as a calm verdict, which an age bound alone can never catch because a fossil written this week is perfectly fresh (the 2026-06-29 red/danger-100/1-indicator row is the same class, proving the floor rejects on evidence count, not direction). Fail-safe is UNAVAILABLE, never calm: an absent verdict is not a benign one. MEASURED IMPACT: 0 of 24 India signals flip long->neutral — the contamination was real but not currently outcome-changing, which is why it survived unnoticed. TABLE CORRECTION: the edge label macro_signals was simply false — danger_score/regime live on macro_regime (migration 028); macro_signals holds per-indicator rows (indicator/value/signal) and has no danger_score or regime column at all (verified against prod information_schema on 2026-07-17). No migration: adding a market column to macro_regime would be a schema change and is deliberately NOT done here.

history.label: Macro read (Agent Mind Phase 3) added to the map and scoped US-only; the India read is KILLED, not faked (mr-v1 -> mr-v2)
history.reason: The LLM-NARRATIVE sibling of the macro_score contamination above, and the reason this node had to exist on the map at all: it shipped with two active crons and a real table dependency but was never drawn, so its India contamination was invisible here. app/api/agent-mind/macro-read/route.ts read macro_regime with NO market filter, stamped MARKET: INDIA into the prompt, and wrote market=india rows every weekday (kairos-macro-read-india, jobid 47, 30 4 * * 1-5). Prod row id=6 (2026-07-13, market=india) reads: 'no regime-based bias can be assigned to this India book. The system's high-conviction belief (80%) that rising Fed funds rates comp[resses]...' against a 13-position India book. CRITICAL SECOND SOURCE found while fixing: the regime in that row was ALREADY 'unknown', so withholding only the regime would NOT have prevented that sentence — learning_priors WHERE category='macro' is ALSO unmarket-tagged and explicitly US (prior id=8 'Rising Fed funds rate environment...' at confidence 0.80 is verbatim the leak; also DXY, 2Y/10Y curve, ISM/PMI, VIX). BOTH macro inputs are US-only. KILL-NOT-HONEST-NARRATIVE decision: once both are honestly withheld, an India read has ZERO macro evidence left — only the held symbols. An LLM asked for a macro read with no macro input either restates a CONSTANT ('we know nothing', which does not need a deepseek-reasoner call every weekday) or reaches into training knowledge for RBI/rupee/FII colour, inventing exactly what the prompt forbids. So India is refused at the route on BOTH verbs before any LLM call or DB write (zero spend, zero rows, legacy India rows unreachable), and MacroReadCard renders a deterministic not-supported note. This also CORRECTS a self-contradiction already on the India page, which renders NotSupportedNote 'TradingView sector overview, macro sentinel & leveraged-pair sentiment' while a cron wrote an India read derived from that same US-only sentinel. PARITY means both markets get an HONEST answer, not that both get an LLM call. lib/india-macro.ts (NSE FII/DII) is deliberately NOT wired in as a substitute regime — that is a separate approved build. US path additionally reuses the scores.ts discipline (unknown-guard, 10-day age bound, raw_indicators >= 3 floor, fail-safe to UNAVAILABLE) so the narrative can no longer describe a fossil as calm, and no rejected row's summary/indicators are interpolated. CRON SILENCE FIXED (separate root cause, same file): macro_interpretations had written NOTHING since 2026-07-13 despite both crons reporting success — prod agent_config sets macro-read to deepseek-reasoner, which streams chain-of-thought into reasoning_content before emitting content, and maxTokens was 600. The moment macro_regime gained a real 7-indicator row (2026-07-13 12:30 UTC) the prompt got meaty enough that reasoning alone ate the budget: every run from 2026-07-13 13:30 onward failed with finish_reason=length, reasoning_len~2500 and empty content, llm-router threw, the catch returned a 200 ok:false, and nothing was written while pg_cron logged 'succeeded' (it only proves the HTTP post was enqueued). maxTokens 600 -> 1500, the identical fix research-agent.ts already made (512 -> 1500). Still NARRATIVE-ONLY: macro_interpretations is read back by this route's own GET alone and by no scoring/sizing/gate/order/exit path (verified by grepping every consumer). No migration. FLAGGED, NOT DONE: the kairos-macro-read-india cron row should be dropped (a prod DB mutation, owner's call) — the route-level refusal makes it harmless meanwhile.

history.label: Risk dashboard now READS agent_signals to annotate each holding with its research score and AGE (new dotted DISPLAY-ONLY edge RESEARCH -.-> RISKDASH)
history.reason: New TABLE DEPENDENCY, so the diagram moves: RISKDASH reads agent_signals, which it never did before. The edge is drawn dotted and labelled 'DISPLAY ONLY -- never enters computeHoldingRisk or sba-v1', and it deliberately terminates at RISKDASH (the dashboard) and NOT at HOLDINGRISK (the engine). That is the whole point of the shape: two independent arrows converge on the display -- HOLDINGRISK -->|snapshots| RISKDASH carries the verdict, RESEARCH -.->|display only| RISKDASH carries the annotation -- and they never meet upstream. Show both, couple neither. WHY THE COUPLING IS REFUSED (do not 'improve' this into a real edge): the risk engine is research-free BY DESIGN. A sector is over-cap *because* research liked that sector, so letting analyst_score also veto the cap double-counts the same signal; the risk layer exists to be the one thing not persuaded by the score. The owner integrates the two views -- that is where judgment belongs. This supersedes the unmerged features/risk-research-integration proposal (branch worktree-agent-abaf0b16ef6af4175), which wanted research to ORDER which names absorb a sector trim; not pursued. WHY IT EXISTS: on 2026-07-16 AVGO sat 6 days unscored while this very panel told the owner to trim it, and nothing on screen said so. THE AGE IS THE FEATURE, NOT THE SCORE. Staleness is counted in market-local SESSIONS (reusing marketSessionsSince from lib/trading/paper-exit-policy.ts, built on the market-local holiday calendar) and only displayed in days -- a calendar-day rule would paint the whole book stale every Monday (a Friday score read Monday is 3 days but ONE session) and train the owner to ignore the warning. Four states that are NOT collapsed: fresh / stale (> 2 sessions, the owner-set threshold) / never (no signal ever -- not a link, because a link to nothing is a lie) / unavailable (abstained -- never rendered as a number). Join is on (symbol, market), never symbol alone. Fail-soft: an agent_signals error leaves the risk table rendering with an explicit 'research unavailable' -- risk is the product, research is the annotation. Measured against prod before trusting the join (dionkikgdmlaotvtbnfr): is_holding is FALSE in 463/463 rows -- no holding-path score has ever been written -- so every annotated row is labelled a screener CANDIDATE score, not a holding verdict; a 'neutral' from that path does not mean 'no exit signal', it means the exit question was never asked (the direction gate can only emit `short` when isHeld is true). ADDITIVE ONLY: no schema change, no migration, no new cron, no provider call, no LLM. HOLDINGRISK, its formula version, and every order path are untouched.

history.label: Added the Evidence Cohort Builder — the first producer of evidence_policy_evaluations rows
history.reason: Prod verified before the change: both markets router_enabled=false, active policy v1, and evidence_policy_evaluations held 0 rows. The router cutover prerequisites (intent classification, degradation guard, parity comparator, bound activation RPC) were all shipped but unfed, so no parity evaluation existed. This node resolves real recent decisions into a frozen cohort and writes the first evaluations. Table dependencies added: reads agent_signals + research_packets + evidence_cache_v2 via the resolver, writes evidence_policy_evaluations + evidence_evaluation_details. No migration — every column already existed. Drawn as a DOTTED edge from RESEARCH and terminating at the evaluation store, never at a scorer: router_enabled stays false, so the flow has zero effect on scoring, signals, sizing, or orders. First runs: US 15 symbols passed all machine gates (0 flips); India 12 symbols correctly FAILED on required-field coverage (no India daily-bars adapter exists), proving the two markets are evaluated independently.
